report.explanation: All admitted telemetry is healthy: gateway checkout trace OK at 65ms, p95 77ms, error_rate 0.001, zero dependency timeouts and pool waiters, and INFO/200 logs across gateway, order, and payment. No evidence supports any taxonomy cause, and healthy telemetry contradicts the degraded-health alert. Root cause cannot be bounded; hand off for further data.
missing_evidence: Telemetry showing actual checkout degradation (elevated error rate, latency, or timeouts) in the alert window
Per-service latency/error breakdown to localize the degraded component
Dependency timeout and DB pool saturation data at the time of degradation
Logs or traces exhibiting errors rather than all-OK request completions
